stories.title: Mumbai leads as Indian AI startups raise $1.6 billion
stories.summary: Indian AI startups raised $1.6 billion in equity funding between January and September 2026, a 96 percent increase from the same period last year. Mumbai emerged as the leading hub for this capital. The funding surge suggests investors are finding new places to put their money.

stories.title: Matters.AI raises $12 million for enterprise security
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Matters.AI has raised $12 million in a pre-Series A round led by Tanglin Venture Partners. The startup is developing what it describes as an AI Security Engineer for enterprise data. The company has now raised a total of $18.25 million to date.

stories.title: SatSure secures funding for Earth intelligence expansion
stories.summary: Antariksh Venture Capital Fund has invested $7.1 million in Bengaluru-based SatSure, leading the first close of a $23.7 million Series B round. The company plans to use the capital to develop optical satellite payloads and strengthen its AI capabilities for the space economy.

stories.title: Vegapay raises $4.5 million in Series A round
stories.summary: Mumbai-based digital lending platform Vegapay is raising $4.5 million in a Series A round led by Prosus. Existing investors Elevation Capital, Vertex Ventures and Eximius Ventures are also participating. The company issued compulsory convertible preference shares to facilitate the new investment.

stories.title: Vidyakul secures debt funding for vernacular edtech
stories.summary: Gurugram-based edtech startup Vidyakul has raised $1.2 million in debt from the Michael and Susan Dell Foundation. The platform provides Hindi and Gujarati language courses for students in Classes 9 to 12 and plans to expand its AI-powered tools for personalised learning.

stories.title: Cosine Robots raises $2.6 million for actuator production
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based robotics hardware startup Cosine Robots has raised $2.6 million in a round led by Avaana Capital. The company manufactures actuators, which convert control signals into movement for robotic joints. The startup aims to use the funds to scale production of these components.

stories.title: AidenAI raises $32 million for enterprise workflows
stories.summary: Enterprise AI startup AidenAI has raised $32 million in a Series A round led by A91 Partners. The company plans to use the capital to expand its platform and engineering team. Founder Srinivas Kamadi launched the business in 2023 following a career at Infosys.

stories.title: Matters.AI adds $12 million in pre-Series A funding
stories.summary: Cybersecurity startup Matters.AI has raised $12 million in a pre-Series A round led by Tanglin Venture Partners. The company intends to use the funds to strengthen its AI-powered data security platform and expand into North American markets. It reports receiving five term sheets.

stories.title: Zavya raises $2.5 million for jewellery retail expansion
stories.summary: Gurugram-based silver jewellery brand Zavya has raised $2.5 million in a pre-Series A round led by Daksham Growth Ventures. The company, which was founded in 2021, plans to use the capital to strengthen its digital presence and expand its physical retail footprint.

CommerzVentures launches $53 million fund for AI and fintech
stories.summary: CommerzVentures has launched a $53 million fund to back early-stage companies at the intersection of AI and financial services. The fund, anchored by Commerzbank, plans to assemble a portfolio of 25 companies. It is smaller than previous vehicles to concentrate support on earlier stages.

stories.title: Redalpine closes $250 million fund for European deeptech
stories.summary: Swiss venture capital firm Redalpine has closed a $250 million fund to invest in European deep-technology companies. The firm is currently exploring a strategic corridor with the United Arab Emirates to support startups developing AI, energy, and health technologies.

stories.title: Key1 Capital raises $320 million for second fund
stories.summary: Israeli venture capital firm Key1 Capital is raising a $320 million second fund. The firm, founded by former Goldman Sachs executives, reports a 20.6 percent net internal rate of return for its first fund. The new capital reached an initial close ahead of schedule.

stories.title: Key1 Capital targets late-growth tech market
stories.summary: Key1 Capital has raised $320 million for a second fund focused on late-growth technology companies. The firm claims that only four of approximately 210 Israeli venture capital funds primarily target this segment. Most of the new capital came from returning investors.

stories.title: Defence startup Agon raises $70 million
stories.summary: London-based defence startup Agon has raised $70 million at a $450 million valuation. The company is building AI-powered simulations to assist manufacturers in testing autonomous weapons. Investors include Northzone and Lakestar, as capital continues to flow into European military technology.

stories.title: Marlowe raises $277 million for AI infrastructure
stories.summary: Former Microsoft executives have raised $277 million for their new startup, Marlowe. The company aims to design computing systems for AI workloads using chips from AMD and Etched. The founders intend to move beyond Nvidia GPUs to lower costs and increase efficiency.

stories.title: Black Forest Labs targets European AI dominance
stories.summary: German AI startup Black Forest Labs is positioning itself as a rival to OpenAI and Google. Cofounder Andreas Blattmann stated that Europe needs to be more ambitious in its pursuit of global AI giants. The startup is currently backed by Nvidia and a16z.

Ex-Infosys executives launch ₹1,000 Cr deeptech fund
stories.summary: CortexSpark Ventures, founded by former Infosys executives, has launched its debut fund targeting a ₹1,000 Cr corpus to back deeptech and AI startups. The firm has secured SEBI registration as a Category II AIF and plans to back around 20 startups with average cheques of $4 Mn to $5 Mn.

stories.title: Bombay Shaving Company parent enters wellness market
stories.summary: Visage Lines Personal Care, parent of Bombay Shaving Company, has launched rE, a brand offering massage guns and foam rollers. The company is moving into the recovery market, a category the firm describes as poles apart from its existing business but offering scope for vertical expansion.

stories.title: Anthropic shares dip below IPO price
stories.summary: Anthropic shares fell to $76 on Tuesday, dropping below the company's $83 IPO price. The decline follows a debut at $111.50 less than a week ago. Observers have used the stock as a barometer for how public markets value the AI sector.

stories.title: SEBI moves to curb grey market premium reporting
stories.summary: SEBI has advised registered intermediaries and market participants to stop publishing grey market premium figures for upcoming IPOs. The regulator cautioned that these unofficial numbers should not be treated as indicators of potential listing gains. The grey market has been asked to remain unofficial.

Maple raises 5.3 million dollars for private AI
stories.summary: Maple has raised 5.3 million dollars to build AI products that keep user data private, even from the company itself. The startup says it uses encrypted, open-source code and trusted execution environments to verify privacy. The company is currently building the product it promises to protect.

stories.title: Consumer platforms continue using dark patterns
stories.summary: Nearly three-quarters of consumer companies that declared themselves free of dark patterns to the Central Consumer Protection Authority still use deceptive interface practices. A study of 354 platforms found that 74 percent of those who self-declared compliance remain non-compliant. The regulations take effect on January 1.

stories.title: Indian startup Sarvam launches Sarvam Extract API to structure documents - NewsBytes
Prosecutors allege former OpenAI engineer stole secrets
stories.summary: US prosecutors have alleged that former OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan planted a recording device in the company office to intercept trade secrets. Prosecutors are opposing his bail request, citing his limited ties to the US and potential access to resources abroad. The investigation is ongoing.

stories.title: Sarvam AI releases document extraction tool
stories.summary: Sarvam AI has launched an API capable of processing documents up to 500 pages. The company claims its tool offers a competitive accuracy-to-cost ratio, citing scores of 95.4 and 94.4 on its own benchmark. The tool is designed to extract structured data from large, complex files.

stories.title: Investors struggle to filter AI-generated pitches
stories.summary: Venture capital firms are reporting a deluge of AI-generated fundraising outreach that makes it difficult to identify genuine substance. Investors are now using AI to screen deals while simultaneously searching for a human touch to differentiate founders. The technology is currently haunting its own backers.

stories.title: Sarvam AI launches token factory to cut startup AI costs - NewsBytes
AI-polished work complicates hiring processes
stories.summary: Candidates are increasingly using AI to submit perfect CVs and work samples, making it difficult for employers to distinguish between genuine skill and automated output. Experts suggest that hiring managers should look for candidates who verify source data rather than those who simply refine the presentation.

stories.title: Startups prefer vague names to allow for pivots
stories.summary: A Crunchbase analysis suggests that well-funded startups are increasingly choosing names that are both distinctive and vague. Founders are opting for this naming strategy to maintain flexibility as their business models evolve in the fast-paced AI sector. The names are designed to survive even if the business does not.

research.title: A Nepali-Accented English Evaluation Dataset for Automatic Speech Recognition
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems perform strongly on native-English benchmarks, yet their accuracy degrades sharply when the input speech comes from under represented non-native accents. Nepali-accented English is particularly under-served: existing resources either focus on native. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: CausalNTP: A World-Model Recipe for Causal Next-Token Prediction under Noisy Training-data
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper shows that transformer networks trained with next-token prediction (NTP) and gradient descent do not learn to make predictions using only causally-relevant tokens in the left context, irrespective of the causal ordering of tokens during. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Decision models for UAVBench and the viability of edge deployment
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Small language models are often proposed for reasoning onboard a drone. However, a good benchmark score does not tell us whether a model will actually run, and run usefully, on an edge computer. In this paper. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research. However, existing agents rely on harnesses that combine multiple mechanisms, making it difficult to determine how individual components contribute. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Diversity over Scale: Recursive Self-Improvement with Ensembles of Small Open-Weight Models
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The advancement of large language models (LLMs) has significantly enhanced the capabilities of agents across various tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) loops, in which a language model repeatedly rewrites a program and builds on its previous version. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: ESM-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Whether AI Agents Understand Earth System Model Physics and Code
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: AI coding agents that modify Earth System Model (ESM) code must preserve both software interfaces and the physical assumptions encoded in them. We introduce ESM-Bench, a benchmark of 60 developer-commit tasks from 6 repositories: Noah-MP, CLM5. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Engram: Multi-Stage Memory for Agentic Tuning of Heterogeneous Models
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can now tune neural networks, yet without cross-session memory they spend costly trials rediscovering known lessons. Reuse is difficult because production models differ in architecture, training setup and inference budget. We. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
